# memory-for-ai

Supported product: Windows native x64 only. Toolchain: MSYS2 CLANG64. Verification: `scripts/verify-windows.ps1`. No Linux/macOS/ARM64/WSL product support; see WINDOWS-X64.md.

> An open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that indexes a codebase into a persistent knowledge graph of functions, classes, call chains, HTTP routes, and cross-service links. AI coding agents query the graph instead of reading files one by one, answering structural questions with roughly 120x fewer tokens (~3,400 vs ~412,000 across five structural queries). Parses 162 languages via vendored tree-sitter grammars, with Hybrid LSP semantic type resolution for Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, C#, Go, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Perl. Semantic vector search runs on bundled nomic-embed-code embeddings compiled into the native executable — no API key, no Ollama, no Docker. Ships a native self-contained executable (Windows native x64 only) with a built-in graph UI. All processing is local — there is no embedded LLM and no telemetry; the MCP client is the intelligence layer.

## Key facts

- License: MIT, open source.
- Languages: 162 (162 vendored tree-sitter grammars compiled into the binary; count generated into product-metadata.json by scripts/check-product-metadata.py).
- Hybrid LSP type resolution: 10 language families — Python, TypeScript/JavaScript/JSX/TSX, PHP, C#, Go, C/C++, Java, Kotlin, Rust, Perl — a lightweight C implementation of language type-resolution algorithms, structurally inspired by and compatible with tsserver/typescript-go, pyright, gopls, Roslyn, Eclipse JDT, and rust-analyzer.
- MCP tools: 23 (index_repository, search_graph incl. semantic_query vector search, query_graph (read-only Cypher subset), trace_path, get_code_snippet, edit_symbol, delete_symbol, rename_symbol, move_symbol, undo_edit, get_graph_schema, compare_graphs, get_architecture, search_code, get_code_actions, list_projects, delete_project, index_status, check_index_coverage, detect_changes, manage_adr, ingest_traces, get_runtime_traces).
- Coverage honesty: index_repository / index_status / check_index_coverage report skipped files, parse_partial line ranges, a file-hash coverage_ratio, and machine-readable confidence_reasons; absence of a flag is never a completeness guarantee.
- Per-project isolation: `install --project` writes a repo-local `.mcp.json` server entry named memory-for-ai-<repo> pinned with `--scope=<repo>` — one fenced graph per repository, zero global config changes; one binary still serves all repositories.
- Team sharing: `index_repository(persistence=true)` writes a compressed `.memory-for-ai/graph.db.zst` artifact teammates bootstrap from instead of re-indexing.
- Cross-service linking: HTTP route ↔ call-site matching, gRPC/GraphQL/tRPC detection, pub/sub channels (EMITS/LISTENS_ON), and CROSS_* edges across multiple indexed repos.
- Supported agents: 45 automatic/conditional client surfaces (39 automatically detected + 6 conditional/explicit): Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Zed, OpenCode, Antigravity, Aider, KiloCode, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Augment / Auggie, OpenClaw, Kiro, Junie, Hermes, OpenHands, Cline, Warp, Qwen Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, Factory Droid, Crush, Goose, Mistral Vibe, Grok Build, Qoder CLI, Kimi Code CLI, GitLab Duo CLI, Rovo Dev CLI, Amp, Devin CLI / Local, Tabnine, Continue / cn (conditional), Visual Studio (conditional, Windows), TRAE (conditional), Roo Code (conditional), Amazon Q Developer IDE, CodeBuddy Code CLI, IBM Bob IDE (conditional), IBM Bob Shell, Pochi, Pi, Sourcegraph Cody (explicit opt-in), Oh My Pi (omp). Each receives documented MCP entries plus skills/instructions/tiered graph agents (Scout/Verify/Auditor) where the client has a safe contract. Preview exact writes with `memory-for-ai install --dry-run`.
- Performance: Linux kernel (28M LOC, 75K files) full index in 3 minutes → 4.81M nodes, 7.72M edges; Cypher queries in under 1ms.
- Evaluation: arXiv:2603.27277 — across 31 real repositories, 10x fewer tokens and 2.1x fewer tool calls vs. file-by-file exploration, at 83% answer quality (92% for the file-by-file baseline).
- Distribution: Windows x64 executable plus authenticated release-owned assets. Wrappers: npm, PyPI and Go; Windows package definitions: Scoop, Winget and Chocolatey.
- Runtime requirements: no language runtime, no Docker, no API key. On Windows, the `search_code` tool shells out to `powershell`, so `powershell.exe` must be on PATH (check `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0` is in the system PATH). Deferred executable cleanup also starts Windows PowerShell from the system directory; if that helper cannot start, Windows reboot deletion is attempted and can fail when the current user lacks permission. Freshness checks, the watcher, and `detect_changes` shell out to `git` on Windows.
- Machine preflight before install (Windows x64, disk, PowerShell, git and existing-install/update detection): docs/INSTALL.md.

## Docs

- [Agent operating guide](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md): the complete manual for AI agents — mental model, all 23 tools with exact semantics, task→tool playbooks, correctness protocol (coverage/confidence/staleness), per-project tuning (.cbmignore, extra extensions, index modes), project isolation, CI/containers, failure modes.
- [Development standard](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPMENT-STANDARD.md): warning-as-error policy, verification matrix, minimal-change rules, and documentation synchronization checklist.
- [Installation reference](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): every install path — one-liners, per-project mode, package managers, manual MCP config, CI/containers, update/uninstall, build from source, artifact verification.
- [Configuration reference](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/CONFIGURATION.md): config files, config-set runtime keys, environment variables, scoped sessions, daemon rendezvous.
- [Measuring real effectiveness](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/MEASURING.md): 15-minute spot check, built-in measurement surfaces, rigorous A/B protocol with formulas and reporting schema.
- [A/B results on this repo](https://github.com/LonelyTraderBay/memory-for-ai/blob/main/docs/AB-RESULTS.md): worked self-measurement — 8 questions, graph 8/8 PASS at ~3.4K est. tokens vs file-by-file 6 PASS + 2 PARTIAL at ~765K est. tokens; includes the stale-index freshness incident, the fixed ~9K-token tool-manifest cost, and full limitations (non-blind grading, bytes-based token estimate).
